text: Election of the Vice Chair of the Infrastructure and Environment Committee under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix A-2, for a term of office ending December 31, 2020, and until a successor is appointed.

The Infrastructure and Environment Committee: 1. Elected Councillor Jennifer McKelvie as Vice Chair of the Infrastructure and Environment Committee for a term of office starting January 17, 2019 and ending December 31, 2020, and until a successor is appointed.
